headline: Canada's Carney welcomes the EU's bid for closer ties amid pressure from Trump
context: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney speaks to the European Parliament, following the European Union's invitation to Canada to become the bloc's first "associate member," which rankled President Trump.

sources.name: NPR
